design.motif: A network-cable tester's silicone service surface: fine dry elastomer grain, several parallel shallow cable channels and two staggered connector seat impressions at one edge. A tiny quiet terracotta endpoint, no retry loop, literal cable tester, status lights, text or readable wiring diagram.

description.en: Fine dry elastomer grain, several parallel shallow cable channels and two staggered connector seat impressions at one edge.
description.zh: 干爽弹性材质上的平行线槽与错位接口座，承接网络检测工具的连接关系，不把纹理当作健康状态。

design.rationale: The existing object, character or historical mark remains unchanged. Only a supporting working surface is interpreted from the product's purpose; no replacement Logo is generated.

description.en: Check your network connection before letting a command run.
description.zh: 在执行命令之前，先确认网络连接符合预期。

purpose.en: Check that a configured URL returns a successful HTTP response and optionally matches response content before starting a command, with project or user configuration and reusable Node.js APIs.
purpose.zh: 在启动命令前，确认指定 URL 返回成功响应并按需匹配内容；支持项目或用户配置，以及可复用的 Node.js API。

rights: Owner-commissioned Azure OpenAI generated decoration under applicable provider terms. No third-party reference image or font was submitted. Existing Logo, font and product rights are unchanged. Do not describe raster output as handmade SVG or assert exclusive trademark rights.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on every native RGBA pixel composited over actual Hexly normal/hover surfaces, before the left-edge mask. Text remains fully opaque.

publication: Export-time record. Upload receipts and the site release establish subsequent publication.
